subject: Sponsors on Arc: USDC escrow with approvals, gasless EIP-3009 posting, funding from Circle Gateway
body:
Posting and topping up a task approve the exact USDC first and pass the
amount to createTask/fundTask. /post can also fund a task from a Circle
Gateway unified balance on another chain (burn intent signed in the
wallet, minted on Arc by the server) and post it without gas through
createTaskWithAuthorization (EIP-3009, relayed).

subject: Contract tests for Arc; close filled tasks, funder-only licence fee, no starving the verdict
body:
156 unit tests (Chainlink Local CCIP, EIP-3009 task funding, blocklisted
payouts, ERC-8004 verdicts with mock registries) and 17 Arc-testnet fork
tests under Circle's Arc Foundry (real USDC, FiatToken signatures, P-256
precompile, Memo/CallFrom, ERC-8004 registries, CCTP burn, CCIP router).

Review fixes in ThenarProtocol: a filled task's funder can reclaim what
imperfect runs left; only the funder sets a policy's licence fee; a run
sent with too little gas for the ERC-8004 verdict is refused rather than
paid without its record; closeTask on a missing id is NoSuchTask.

subject: Arc chain layer: networks, deployments, fork bootstrap, shared Arc modules
body:
lib/chain.ts picks Arc testnet, mainnet or a local Arc Foundry fork from
NEXT_PUBLIC_ARC_NETWORK; addresses come from deployments/arc-<network>.json
through scripts/apply-deploy.mjs (the fork's from .env.fork). USDC is the
currency everywhere: 6-decimal contract amounts, 18-decimal native gas.

scripts/arc-fork.mjs forks Arc testnet with Circle's Arc Foundry, makes
throwaway role keys, deploys with Deploy.s.sol, registers the verifier and
a buyer agent in Arc's real ERC-8004 Identity Registry and binds
ThenarVerdicts. scripts/deploy.sh holds the shared deployer lock only for
the broadcast. Pure helpers for Gateway burn intents, CCTP V2 withdrawals,
Arc Memo (with a CallFrom probe), ERC-8004 and USDC amounts.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
